title: Complete Irish Lebor Gabála Érenn Part IV: Nemedian Pedigree from Magog, All 9 Fir Bolg Kings & Complete Tuatha Dé Danann Pantheon (Macalister)

nodes.name: Irish Universal Pedigree: Noah → Japheth → Magog → Fathacht → Sera → Agnomain → Nemed (Ancestor of Fir Bolg, Britons & Tuatha Dé Danann!)
nodes.era: Mythic Irish Settlements (Lebor Gabála Érenn R1 ¶316, p. 127)
nodes.role: Bridge Uniting Genesis 10 (Magog) to Ireland's Pre-Milesian Peoples
sources: Lebor Gabála Érenn Part IV (Macalister ¶280, ¶316, pp. 9, 127)
nodes.notes: Macalister R1 ¶316 traces Nemed directly from Noah -> Japheth -> Magog -> Fathacht -> Braimend -> Esru -> Sru -> Sera -> Tat -> Pamp -> Agnomain -> Nemed! Nemed's surviving branches produced the Fir Bolg (via Starn -> Semeon -> Dela), the Britons (Britán Máel), and the Tuatha Dé Danann (via Iarbonel the Soothsayer -> Bethach -> Tat)!

nodes.name: Complete Fir Bolg Dynasty (Dela's 5 Sons & All 9 Kings): Sláine, Rudraige, Gann, Genann, Sengann → Fiacha → Rindail → Fodbgenid → Eochu mac Eirc (+ Queen Tailtiu)
nodes.era: Pre-Tuatha Dé Ireland (Lebor Gabála Part IV Sect. VI, pp. 7-21)
nodes.role: First Organizers of Ireland's Five Provinces & Tailteann Games
sources: Lebor Gabála Érenn Part IV (Macalister ¶278-289, pp. 7-21)
nodes.notes: Dela's 5 sons & 5 wives (Sláine+Fuat, Gann+Etar, Sengann+Anust, Genann+Cnucha, Rudraige+Liber) divided Ireland into its 5 provinces (Cóiceda). Last king Eochu mac Eirc married Spanish princess Tailtiu (foster-mother of Lugh!) before falling at 1st Battle of Mag Tuired.

nodes.name: Tuatha Dé Danann Line A & B1: Nuadu Airgetlám ('Silver Hand'), Midir & Esarg's 4 Sons (Goibniu, Creidne, Luichtne & Dian Cécht → Cian + Ethniu → Lugh Lámfada!)
nodes.era: Battle of Mag Tuired (Lebor Gabála Part IV Sect. VII, pp. 113-159)
nodes.role: Silver-Handed King Nuadu, Divine Craftsmen & Hero-King Lugh Lámfada
sources: Lebor Gabála Érenn Part IV (Macalister ¶310-316, ¶341, pp. 113-159)
nodes.notes: Nuadu Airgetlám ruled 27 yrs after healer Dian Cécht & Creidne forged his silver hand. Dian Cécht's son Cian married Ethniu (daughter of Fomorian King Balor of the Evil Eye!), fathering Lugh Lámfada ('Long-Arm', master of all arts!), who slew grandfather Balor at 2nd Mag Tuired and reigned 40 yrs!

nodes.name: Tuatha Dé Danann Line B2 (Elada's Sons): The Dagda (Eochu Ollathair → Óengus Mac Óc, Brigit & Cermait → Mac Cuill/Mac Cécht/Mac Gréine) & Ogma (→ Delbaeth → Ériu, Banba, Fódla & 3 Sons of Danu)
nodes.era: Tuatha Dé Danann Golden Age (Lebor Gabála Part IV Sect. VII, pp. 121-197)
nodes.role: The Great Dagda, Goddess Brigit, Ogma & Eponymous Queens of Ireland
sources: Lebor Gabála Érenn Part IV (Macalister ¶313-317, ¶335-344, pp. 121-197)
nodes.notes: Elada fathered Eochu Ollathair (The Great Dagda, reigned 80 yrs -> Óengus Mac Óc, poetess-goddess Brigit, and Cermait -> joint kings Mac Cuill, Mac Cécht, Mac Gréine), Ogma (inventor of Ogham -> Delbaeth -> Fiachna -> Ériu [Ireland!], Banba & Fódla, plus the 3 Gods of Danann: Brian, Iuchar, Iucharba), and Bres (half-Fomorian king)!
